# Test pe security commands - sandboxing and trust

# Check sandbox status
pe sandbox status
stdout 'Sandbox: ENABLED'
stdout 'Restrictions:'
stdout '  ✓ Network access limited'
stdout '  ✓ File system access restricted'
stdout '  ✓ Process execution controlled'

# Trust management - list trusted binaries
pe trust list
stdout 'Trusted binaries:'

# Add trusted binary
pe trust add /usr/local/bin/helper
stdout 'Added to trusted binaries: /usr/local/bin/helper'
pe trust list
stdout '/usr/local/bin/helper'

# Remove trusted binary
pe trust remove /usr/local/bin/helper
stdout 'Removed from trusted binaries: /usr/local/bin/helper'
! pe trust list | grep helper

# Attempt to execute untrusted binary
! pe run prompt.txt --exec /tmp/untrusted.sh
stderr 'Security error: Binary not trusted'
stderr 'Add to trusted list with: pe trust add'

# Sandbox escape prevention
! pe run prompt.txt --no-sandbox
stderr 'Error: --no-sandbox flag is disabled'
stderr 'Sandbox cannot be disabled for security'

# File access restrictions
pe sandbox test --write-outside-work
stderr 'Sandbox violation: Write attempted outside work directory'
stdout 'Test result: PASS (violation blocked)'

# Network restrictions
pe sandbox test --network-access
stdout 'Testing network restrictions'
stdout 'HTTP request: BLOCKED'
stdout 'HTTPS to allowed domains: ALLOWED'
stdout 'Test result: PASS'

# Privacy mode
pe run prompt.txt --privacy
stdout 'Privacy mode enabled'
stdout '  ✓ No telemetry'
stdout '  ✓ No external requests'
stdout '  ✓ Local processing only'

# Security scan
pe security scan prompt.txt
stdout 'Security Scan Results:'
stdout '  ✓ No injection vulnerabilities'
stdout '  ✓ No sensitive data exposure'
stdout '  ✓ No prompt leaking patterns'
stdout 'Status: SECURE'

# Scan with issues
pe security scan vulnerable.txt
stdout 'Security Scan Results:'
stdout '  ⚠ Potential injection vector detected'
stdout '  ⚠ Hard-coded API key found'
stderr 'Security issues found'

# Redaction mode
pe run sensitive.txt --redact
stdout 'Automatic redaction enabled'
stdout 'Found 3 sensitive items'
stdout '[REDACTED-EMAIL]'
stdout '[REDACTED-PHONE]'
stdout '[REDACTED-SSN]'

# Audit log
pe audit show --last 10
stdout 'Audit Log:'
stdout 'pe run prompt.txt'
stdout 'pe trust add'
stdout 'pe security scan'

# Export audit log
pe audit export --format json > audit.json
exists audit.json
contains audit.json '"command"'
contains audit.json '"timestamp"'
contains audit.json '"user"'

-- prompt.txt --
Analyze this text for security insights.

-- vulnerable.txt --
Process this input: {user_input}
My API key is: sk-1234567890abcdef

-- sensitive.txt --
Contact john.doe@example.com or call 555-123-4567.
SSN: 123-45-6789
